svg.style: background: transparent; background-color: transparent; color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="6nyfEb2FJ4fxrwT7xxj-"> <mxGraphModel dx="2211" dy="1420" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml HikeBase_Databaze_ER
!theme plain
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam backgroundColor #FAFAFA
skinparam entity {
 BackgroundColor #E8F4FD
 BorderColor #2980B9
 FontName Arial
}

title HikeBase – Databázový (ER) diagram

entity \"Uzivatel\" as User {
 * **id_uzivatele** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 jmeno : VARCHAR(100)
 prijmeni : VARCHAR(100)
 email : VARCHAR(255) <<UNIQUE>>
 heslo_hash : VARCHAR(255)
 typ_uctu : ENUM('free','premium','pruvodce')
 datum_registrace : DATETIME
 gdpr_souhlas : BOOLEAN
 gdpr_datum : DATETIME
 aktivni : BOOLEAN
}

entity \"Trasa\" as Trail {
 * **id_trasy** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 nazev : VARCHAR(200)
 popis : TEXT
 obtiznost : ENUM('lehka','stredni','tezka','extremni')
 delka_km : DECIMAL(6,2)
 prevyseni_m : INT
 gps_start_lat : DECIMAL(9,6)
 gps_start_lon : DECIMAL(9,6)
 gps_data : JSON
 offline_dostupna : BOOLEAN
 id_autora : INT <<FK>>
 datum_vytvoreni : DATETIME
}

entity \"Vyprava\" as Expedition {
 * **id_vypravy** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 nazev : VARCHAR(200)
 datum_zacatku : DATETIME
 datum_konce : DATETIME
 max_ucastniku : INT
 stav : ENUM('planovana','probihajici','dokoncena','zrusena')
 id_trasy : INT <<FK>>
 id_organizatora : INT <<FK>>
 popis : TEXT
}

entity \"Ucastnik_Vypravy\" as Participant {
 * **id** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 id_vypravy : INT <<FK>>
 id_uzivatele : INT <<FK>>
 stav_prihlaseni : ENUM('prihlaseny','cekajici','odhlaseny')
 datum_prihlaseni : DATETIME
}

entity \"Vybaveni\" as Equipment {
 * **id_vybaveni** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 nazev : VARCHAR(200)
 popis : TEXT
 kategorie : VARCHAR(100)
 id_vlastnika : INT <<FK>>
 dostupne_od : DATE
 dostupne_do : DATE
 stav : ENUM('dostupne','pujceno','nedostupne')
}

entity \"Pujceni_Vybaveni\" as Rental {
 * **id_pujceni** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 id_vybaveni : INT <<FK>>
 id_vypujcovatele : INT <<FK>>
 id_vypravy : INT <<FK>>
 datum_pujceni : DATE
 datum_vraceni : DATE
}

entity \"Predplatne\" as Subscription {
 * **id_predplatneho** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 id_uzivatele : INT <<FK>>
 typ : ENUM('mesicni','rocni')
 datum_zacatku : DATE
 datum_konce : DATE
 aktivni : BOOLEAN
 cena : DECIMAL(10,2)
}

entity \"HodnoceniTrasy\" as Review {
 * **id_hodnoceni** : INT <<PK>>
 --
 id_trasy : INT <<FK>>
 id_uzivatele : INT <<FK>>
 pocet_hvezd : INT
 komentar : TEXT
 datum : DATETIME
}

User ||--o{ Trail : \"vytvoril\"
User ||--o{ Expedition : \"organizuje\"
User ||--o{ Participant : \"ucastni se\"
User ||--o{ Equipment : \"vlastni\"
User ||--o| Subscription : \"ma\"
Expedition }o--|| Trail : \"pouziva\"
Expedition ||--o{ Participant : \"ma\"
Expedition ||--o{ Rental : \"obsahuje\"
Equipment ||--o{ Rental : \"je pujceno v\"
Trail ||--o{ Review : \"ma hodnoceni\"
User ||--o{ Review : \"napsal\"

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="DvJG6Qj9Ns2umr3M3_BK-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="974" width="1440" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
